title: SOC 1, Type 2 Report
description: The SOC 1, Type 2 report documents GitHub's internal controls that may be relevant to a customer's financial statements. The GitHub SOC reporting periods conclude September 30 and March 31. New SOC 1 & SOC 2 reports will be available by the end of November and May respectively.

title: SOC2, Type 2 Report
description: The SOC 2, Type 2 report documents GitHub's internal controls that may be relevant to a customer's financial statements. The GitHub SOC reporting periods conclude September 30 and March 31. New SOC 1 & SOC 2 reports will be available by the end of November and May respectively.

title: SOC 2, Type 2 Bridge Letter
description: Accompanying bridge letter for the SOC 1, Type 2 report.

title: GitHub.com CSA STAR Level 2 certification
description: This certificate is evidence of the GitHub's conformance with the Cloud Controls Matrix (CCM) in coordination with an assessment of the ISO/IEC 27001:2013 standard performed by an ANAB-accredited certification body.

title: GitHub.com ISO/IEC 27001:2013 certification
description: The ISO/IEC 27001 certificate confirms the Information Security Management System (ISMS) supporting the operations underlying GitHub.com.

title: GitHub.com Services Continuity and Incident Management Plan
description: The Services Continuity and Incident Management Plan documents the measures GitHub has taken to respond to significant business disruptions.

title: CSA CAIQ
description: The Cloud Security Alliance Consensus Assessment Initiative Questionnaire (CSA-CAIQ or CAIQ) is a self-assessment that evaluates a cloud provider against CSA's Cloud Control Matrix.

title: Bug Bounty
description: Reports for the GitHub Bug Bounty program used to continuously assess and harden GitHub's products and services. The scope of the Bug Bounty program can be found at https://bounty.github.com.
